mostWorthwhile.text: Making a specific spring-tide prediction and comparing it with observations was the strongest passage: it connected the myth to a testable claim while distinguishing support from proof.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated dead ends before finding Language were frustrating; plausible connections to seasons and the shore offered little direction about the missing intermediate.

surprise.text: Wonder initially had no available partners, but became useful once the community had Language. The spring-tide prediction also clarified that the name refers to tidal range, not the season.

arbitrary.text: The hypothesis could not meet the shore directly and needed the Calendar first. The eventual prediction explains why timing matters, but that prerequisite was not clear when I first tried the shore.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what harder questions the community asks next; the final shared discovery offers a promising hook, though I would hope for clearer guidance around blocked combinations.
